topic: automatic review requests after every job
hook: If your happy customers never leave reviews, this is for you.
caption:
Automatic review requests for contractors: comment STARS and I'll reply with how it works.

Friday: you finish the roof. The customer loves it. Monday: still no review, because they forgot. This robot messages them the same day you finish, with one link straight to your Google profile, so leaving 5 stars takes them about 10 seconds.

Google's own help page says reviews can help you show up higher.

#contractor #googlereviews #smallbusinesstips #automation #n8n
